text:
Ajay: Quick question — for the inference control-plane we need per-request tenant/route quota + full tracing. Do we expose a single JSON REST endpoint for web SDKs or push gRPC streaming and add a thin JSON facade at the edge?
Sylvie: leaning gRPC for internal services (perf, streaming), but JSON facade adds maintenance. Is telemetry/trace propagation easier w/ gRPC metadata?
Kevin: gRPC makes it trivial to attach binary proto metadata and propagate trace/tenant tags. But browser clients can't call gRPC without proxy. That proxy either translates -> complexity.
Marta: console UX prefers stable JSON shape. Quotas UI wants route labels that match user's route names, not internal proto ids.
Ajay: concern is quota accounting. If we do edge translation, we risk losing original route headers unless we preserve them in X-Forwarded-* headers or inject as proto fields.
Sylvie: propose: gRPC internal surface + edge translator that copies: traceparent, x-tenant-id, x-route-id into gRPC metadata. Also add a rare full payload hash header to dedupe caching.
Kevin: +1 but need consistent metric labels — the gateway must emit metrics with both external route and internal method. Otherwise console can't roll up costs.
Marta: can we get the console to accept either? UI can map internal->external name via an alias table, but that's extra plumbing.
Ajay: also rollout plan: start with dual-expose on a small subset of tenants. Canary via header `x-expose=proto` to opt-in. Deploy-bot will do canary.
deploy-bot: Canary started for gateway v2 -> 10% of traffic for tenants with label `edge-proto-canary`. Logs: canary healthy, 200/200 checks.
Kevin: edge translator sample code: ```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-Tenant-Id: t-123
X-Route-Name: chat.v1
Content-Type: application/json

{...}
``` We'll map to `rpc.Generate(GenerateRequest)` and set metadata.
Sylvie: telemetry: ensure we keep trace IDs intact; add metric tag `exposure=json|grpc` to all request metrics + per-route token cost gauge. This keeps cost attribution consistent.
Marta: UX: on console, show a small indicator when a route is served by facade vs native gRPC. Also expose per-exposure latency distribution so PMs can see differences.
Ajay: agreed. Action items: Sylvie -> prototype translator that preserves headers; Kevin -> telemetry mapping PR; Marta -> console mock for exposure flag; I'll schedule a 30m check-in Fri.
Sylvie: :thumbsup:
Kevin: i'll open the proto->json mapping spike tomorrow morning.
Marta: putting a quick Figma frame into #product-ux for review.
Ajay: thanks all — prefer short experiment over big migration, let's keep rollback simple (feature flag + route remap).
